initialization: Deep-copy the initial gene projection after all original initialization; no new RNG draws. Defaults remain shared.
additional_checks: matched initial ESM projection and RNG
legacy shared forward/backward and parameter-order exact compatibility
frozen real main checkpoint strict-load/optimizer/EMA compatibility
